open_points.question: Must ProjectTrackingRepository be restored to IMPORTS and its model surface, or must the return annotation be changed to an available imported type?

open_points.subject: list_project_payments
open_points.text: - list_project_payments: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST read only through list_project_payments of the project_tracking repository of that transaction, never the same-named legacy PortalTransaction method, and close the read transaction by rollback without using legacy tracking methods.
open_points.question: Must the ProjectTrackingRepository.list_project_payments operation and its owning interface be restored, or must the note permit the only declared list_project_payments operation on PortalTransaction?

open_points.subject: list_project_progress
open_points.text: - list_project_progress: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST read only through list_project_progress of the project_tracking repository of that transaction, never the same-named legacy PortalTransaction method, and close the read transaction by rollback without using legacy tracking methods.
open_points.question: Must the ProjectTrackingRepository.list_project_progress operation and its owning interface be restored, or must the note permit the only declared list_project_progress operation on PortalTransaction?

open_points.subject: register_work_payment
open_points.text: - register_work_payment: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST call get_work_payment of the project_tracking repository of that transaction, never the same-named legacy PortalTransaction method, with exactly payment_id, never project_id plus payment_id; it MUST verify an existing payment belongs to the project_id of the context before replay classification.
open_points.other_text: def get_work_payment(self, payment_id: UUID) -> WorkPayment | None
open_points.question: Must the ProjectTrackingRepository.get_work_payment operation and its owning interface be restored, or must the note permit the only declared get_work_payment operation on PortalTransaction?

open_points.subject: register_work_payment
open_points.text: - register_work_payment: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST perform all WorkPayment reads/writes through the project_tracking repository of that transaction, pass the audit repository of that transaction to append_audit with reason_code None for success, and commit both writes once; any failure MUST rollback both repositories on the shared transaction.

open_points.question: Must ProjectTrackingRepository and its WorkPayment read/write operations be restored to the imported model surface, or must the requirement use operations that the current imports and contracts provide?

open_points.subject: set_section_progress
open_points.text: - set_section_progress: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open one transaction by beginning a transaction with begin of the store, which returns a PortalTransaction, only after validate_project_section has completed; it MUST perform all SectionProgress reads/writes through the project_tracking repository of that transaction, pass the audit repository of that transaction to append_audit with reason_code None for success, and commit both writes once; any failure after that transaction is opened MUST rollback both repositories on the shared transaction.

open_points.question: Must ProjectTrackingRepository and its SectionProgress read/write operations be restored to the imported model surface, or must the requirement use operations that the current imports and contracts provide?

open_points.subject: register_work_payment
open_points.text: - register_work_payment: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST build the new = models.WorkPayment with the imported build_work_payment, passing the context, the supplied payment_id, payment_date and description, the validated amount and the single utc_now instant as now, and its audit intent with the imported build_project_audit_intent, passing the context, the payment.register member of = models.AuditAction, the work_payment member of = models.AuditEntityKind and the payment_id as entity_id.
open_points.question: Must the note name the declared WORK_PAYMENT member, or must the enum surface define a lowercase work_payment member?

open_points.subject: set_section_progress
open_points.text: - set_section_progress: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST build the upserted = models.SectionProgress with the imported build_section_progress, passing the context, the section_id, the completion_percent _validate_completion_percent accepted and the single utc_now instant as now, and its audit intent with the imported build_project_audit_intent, passing the context, the progress.update member of = models.AuditAction, the section_progress member of = models.AuditEntityKind and the section_id as entity_id.
open_points.question: Must the note name the declared SECTION_PROGRESS member, or must the enum surface define a lowercase section_progress member?

open_points.subject: PortalTransaction.project_tracking
open_points.rule:
`module_internal[consumer][provider]` — **полный и минимальный** прямой
  runtime import surface consumer-модуля, а не копия публичного API
  provider-а: ровно те символы, которые код consumer-а называет напрямую —
  вызывает, конструирует, проверяет (членство в enum, тип), пишет в
  аннотации. Само наличие символа в `models`, `imports.internal` или
  `module_functions[provider]` зависимостью не является. Недостающий символ —
  такая же ошибка спеки, как лишний: в строгом режиме импортов (ниже)
  сгенерированный модуль без него отвергается
open_points.question: The prompt must import and expose ProjectTrackingRepository as a direct dependency used by this annotation, or remove the annotation's reference to that symbol.

open_points.subject: register_work_payment
open_points.rule:
**Literal-check.** Значение, объявленное в блоке данных, не должно
  встречаться литералом в коде модуля-потребителя. При эмиссии мимо модели это
  инвариант по построению; проверка сохраняется как ассерт сборки и ловит
  протечку значения через notes.
open_points.question: The passage must name the symbolic WORK_PAYMENT enum member rather than leaking its work_payment data value through the note.
